{{Quote|It is pleasing. Nadrin Tro, on loan from the New Thinking Division of the Science Bureau|Nadrin Tro introduces himself|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''New Thinking Division''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Nadrin Tro]] was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] from this division of the Bureau who was selected to aid the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Conquest of Makeb|mission]] on [[Makeb]] in acquiring [[isotope-5]]. Unlike the typical Imperial, Nadrin Tro was not a [[Human/Legends|human]]; instead he was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]], selected for service for his loyalty to the Empire.
